places.publicNote: School associated with Kaper’s secondary education and matura, identified as Gimnazjum im. Stanisława Staszica w Warszawie at ul. Polna 60. The coordinates indicate the address area without establishing continuity of the historical school building.
Warsaw birthplace context associated with Sienna 44. The coordinates indicate the address area; exact continuity between the 1902 property and the modern address point remains unverified.

places.publicNote: Warsaw school associated with Kaper’s early education before his Staszic Gymnasium period, at ul. Żórawia 49 (modern Żurawia 49). The coordinates indicate the address area without establishing survival of the historical school building.
